info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 航太工程涵跨多項專業領域，各領域性質差異頗大，且授課時程亦先後不一，為了提高本系新生對航太工程之認知與興趣，同時作為往後三年貫通修習各不同領域專業課程之基礎，乃以本課程將航太工程各領域之內容與相互之關聯，作一整體性概念式的介紹。課程內容有：航空發展史、空氣動力學、飛行動力學、推進、結構與材料、太空飛行史、火箭與人造衛星運動原理、國際民航市場現況、國際太空科技發展現況等。同時為了驗證飛機飛行及火箭推進之原理，每位學生須製作一架手擲模型飛機與一枚水動力火箭，並且要經過實地試飛與射擊之測試，另外每人還須能在電腦上熟練操作指定之飛行模擬軟體。本課程除了航太專業領域之介紹，同時也擔負航太工程師『工程倫理』的教育與培養。本課程將結合航太科技發展史上眾多航太先驅之卓越事蹟為藍本，闡述航太專業人員該具有的正確『工程倫理』準則。再則，基於教學相長及服務社會雙重目的，本課程特地將『服務學習』納入課程內容，學期中透過系列規劃之服務活動，一則可激勵學生學習情緒，達到教學相長之目的；再則藉由服務之過程，可培養人際之溝通、合作及領導能力。
description.describe_eh:
Aerospace engineering contains wide range of specialized areas.  The variances between each area are numerous, also the timing of lecturing these areas is different. In order to inspire the interests and knowledge about aerospace engineering for the freshmen of department, we design this course to link each relative material within the field of aerospace engineering. Our goal is by this whole conceptual introductory course to make students to have the fundamental knowledge for the next 3 years' study. The contexts of this course are: the history of aviation, aerodynamics, flight dynamics, propulsion, structures and materials, space flight history, the principles of motion for rockets and satellites, survey of international civil aviation market, and overview of international space technologies.  At the same time, students must to make their own hand-launched glider and water-propelled rocket in the semester in order to practice the theories learnt about airplane and rocket from lectures. The hand-launched glider and the water-propelled rocket must pass the trial of flying and launching.
In addition, students are expected to be skilled in operation of the computer flight simulation program.
Other than lecturing the specialized knowledge in aerospace field, this course is also responsible for cultivation of "Engineering Ethic" among the future aerospace engineers.  This course is going to take the most outstanding stories in the history of aerospace technology as blue prints to elaborate the correct "Engineering Ethic" standard which is must have to all people in aerospace field.
Based on the purposes of "benefit from teaching" and contribution to the society, this course takes in the concept of "Service Learning".  Through the planned servicing activities during the semester, not only the learning spirits of the students can be inspired but also the abilities of communication, cooperation and leadership can be benefited.
